item.text: {"trigger_map":{"schema_version":"trigger-map.v0.1","triggers":[{"trigger_id":"T1","source_anchor_quote_en":"The smaller the society, the fewer probably will be the distinct parties and interests composing it; the fewer the distinct parties and interests, the more frequently will a majority be found of the same party","unexplained_relation_zh":"文中断言：社会规模变大、利益类型变多后，多数派更难稳定形成；但中间缺少“哪些分化结构会让多数联盟难以持续”的解释变量。","possible_missing_variable_zh":"cross-cutting cleavages／利益分化是否彼此重叠"},{"trigger_id":"T2","source_anchor_quote_en":"the smaller the number of individuals composing a majority, and the smaller the compass within which they are placed, the more easily will they concert and execute their plans of oppression","unexplained_relation_zh":"文中把地理与人数规模直接连到压迫计划更易实施，但没有展开“为什么大群体更难合谋”的组织机制。","possible_missing_variable_zh":"coordination costs／监督成本／搭便车问题"},{"trigger_id":"T3","source_anchor_quote_en":"what are many of the most important acts of legislation, but so many judicial determinations ... the parties are, and must be, themselves the judges","unexplained_relation_zh":"文中指出立法者往往同时是利益当事人，但没有命名这种制度位置为何会系统性地产生偏向性政策。","possible_missing_variable_zh":"public choice／rent-seeking／利益集团政治"},{"trigger_id":"T4","source_anchor_quote_en":"refine and enlarge the public views, by passing them through the medium of a chosen body of citizens","unexplained_relation_zh":"文中说代表制能“提炼并扩大”公共观点，但缺少解释：代表为何有时能改善判断、何时又会反转为背叛委托人。","possible_missing_variable_zh":"trustee vs delegate representation／selection effects／agency loss"}]},"seed_batch":{"schema_version":"seed-batch.v0.1","run_id":"POS02-R1-V1P","seeds":[{"seed_id":"S1","source_anchor_quote_en":"the smaller the number of individuals composing a majority, and the smaller the compass within which they are placed, the more easily will they concert and execute their plans of oppression. Extend the sphere, and you take in a greater variety of parties and interests","external_lens_identity":"Mancur Olson's collective action theory","mechanism_claim_zh":"这里可用“集体行动成本”重读：多数人并非只要有共同利益就会自动联合；人数变大、地域拉开后，联络、监督、惩罚背离者的成本上升，压迫性联盟更难稳定组织起来。","reread_delta_zh":"重读后会发现，Madison 不是只在说“大国更包容”，还在隐含利用大规模社会的组织摩擦来削弱多数派的行动能力。","source_leads":["Mancur Olson, The Logic of Collective Action (1965)","Russell Hardin, Collective Action (1982)"]},{"seed_id":"S2","source_anchor_quote_en":"Extend the sphere, and you take in a greater variety of parties and interests; you make it less probable that a majority of the whole will have a common motive to invade the rights of other citizens","external_lens_identity":"cross-cutting cleavages in political sociology","mechanism_claim_zh":"可用“交错性社会分裂”解释：如果宗教、地区、职业、财产等分界线彼此不重合，同一批人就不容易在所有议题上结成持久多数，因而压迫性联盟更难固化。","reread_delta_zh":"这样重读后，文中的“variety of parties and interests”不只是数量增加，而是分裂线彼此交叉，从结构上打散单一多数。","source_leads":["Seymour Martin Lipset, Political Man (1960)","Georg Simmel, Conflict and group affiliations (English trans. 1955)"]},{"seed_id":"S3","source_anchor_quote_en":"what are many of the most important acts of legislation, but so many judicial determinations ... the parties are, and must be, themselves the judges","external_lens_identity":"public choice theory of self-interested legislation","mechanism_claim_zh":"这段可借“公共选择”来重读：立法并不天然代表抽象公益，立法者与其支持群体会把政策过程当作分配利益的场域，因此制度风险不只是道德失败，而是激励结构使然。","reread_delta_zh":"重读后，Madison 对 faction 的担忧会从一般性的“党争”收紧为一个制度命题：当裁决者同时是利害相关方，偏向性立法几乎是可预期结果。","source_leads":["James M. Buchanan and Gordon Tullock, The Calculus of Consent (1962)","Dennis C. Mueller, Public Choice III (2003)"]},{"seed_id":"S4","source_anchor_quote_en":"refine and enlarge the public views, by passing them through the medium of a chosen body of citizens","external_lens_identity":"trustee model of representation","mechanism_claim_zh":"可用“受托代表”透镜解释：代表制被寄望于让被选者暂时脱离即时激情与地方偏见，以较长时段、较大范围的判断来处理中介过的公共利益。","reread_delta_zh":"这样重读后，这句话不再只是赞美精英，而是在提出一种具体代表机制：代表制的价值来自判断被中介，而风险则来自代理失灵与筛选失败。","source_leads":["Edmund Burke, Speech to the Electors of Bristol (1774)","Hanna Fenichel Pitkin, The Concept of Representation (1967)"]}]}}
